newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei gains over 500 points in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei gains over 500 points in afternoon.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key index gained more than 500 points in mid-afternoon trade on Monday, as steep falls last week continued to attract purchasers seeking bargains in the banking and brokerage sectors, brokers said. But the rise appeared to be only a technical rebound, they said.
The Nikkei average of 225 leading shares briefly touched 17,815.53, up 511.88, before slipping back a little. Its March futures added 530 points to stand at 17,680.

Brokers said the market was supported by a report by Japan's Jiji news agency saying the secretary-general of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party, Koichi Kato, on Monday called on Taku Yamazaki, chairman of the party's policy-making committee, to come up with measures to deal with weak stock prices.
But the report did not have a strong impact, they said.

Meanwhile, Vice Trade Minister Tsutomu Makino said on Monday that the ministry was not considering taking any special steps to deal with recent weakness in Tokyo stock prices. He told a news conference he did not expect the recent dive in stock prices to hurt the Japanese economy. The Nikkei fell more than 2,000 points last week on worries about the economy and the health of financial institutions.
